John Atcitty in scenario 1 knows that he is a Heavy Equipment Operator with a middle-school education, that Beverly Yan is a teacher with a doctorate, and that they are colleagues collaborating on a joint class project. He knows he has set up the equipment for the demonstration. He does not know for certain how Beverly evaluates him before she speaks, nor whether she might think less of him because of his educational background. Those are his worries, not facts he knows.

At the moment of his dialogue, John’s statement “I hope it meets your expectations” is shaped by his insecurity about his education compared to Beverly’s. His intention is not to propose a future event, engage more openly, or continue honesty; those belong to later scenarios. Rather, he is trying to show that he is capable and competent in his practical area despite his lower formal education. Beverly’s reply directly addresses this by praising his machinery expertise and saying education is not only about degrees.

Therefore, John’s intention in scenario 1 is best described as proving his competence.

ANSWER: c
